ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR(
AND( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "1"), ISBLANK( Level_1_Approver__c ) ),
NOT( Level_1_Approver__r.IsActive ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Level__c , "1"), ISBLANK( Level_1_Approver_Backup__c ) ),
NOT( Level_1_Approver_Backup__r.IsActive )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please specify an Active User for all Deal Level 1 approvers
